In Photos: Britain Grapples With Record Heatwave
A scorching heatwave has gripped Britain, pushing temperatures to unusually high levels and putting pressure on transport, public services and communities. This photo gallery captures the impact of the extreme heat, from sun-baked streets and dried river beds as the country faces increasingly intense summer weather
